subject.title: [Feature]: Guided CLI onboarding with live AI verification (macOS parity) and classic fallback

question: Should default interactive CLI onboarding switch from chat-first setup to a deterministic guided verifier that reuses detectSetupInference and activateSetupInference while preserving classic and non-interactive contracts?
rationale: The requested behavior changes the first-run CLI UX and setup API contract, and the issue carries protected maintainer/product-decision labels.

options.title: Adopt guided verifier by default
options.body: Make flagless interactive CLI onboarding live-test candidates and manual keys before persisting config, while retaining the documented escape hatches.

options.title: Keep chat-first default with repair path
options.body: Leave the current Crestodian conversation as default and add a narrower recovery command for failed inference setup.

options.title: Defer CLI parity
options.body: Keep the macOS verified flow as the only guided verifier until maintainers choose a broader setup direction.

recommendation.title: Adopt guided verifier by default
recommendation.body: Make flagless interactive CLI onboarding live-test candidates and manual keys before persisting config, while retaining the documented escape hatches.

likelyOwner.reason: The same owner carried the related Crestodian, macOS live-verification, and provider-catalog setup changes.
